g.text: Request session token rotation(Refresh token & request ID)
Forward token refresh request via RabbitMQ
Query active refresh token session by hash
Verify user account active and in good standing
Atomically rotate token session(Revoke active token & issue replacement)
Sign new 15-minute access tokenand replacement refresh token
Return rotated access and refresh token pair
Deliver rotated access and refresh token pair
Standard rotation complete; replay original protected request with new access token
